messages:
maria_g: FYI customer AcmeArt opened a ticket — their backfill is failing with a vector-dim mismatch after they flipped to a new embedding model.

patrick: Can you paste the error and which model they switched to?

ingest-bot: job=backfill-789 status=FAILED error=InvalidVectorDim expected=1536 got=1024 attempts=4 first_seen=2026-03-15T09:11:55Z

maria_g: Indexer log (redacted):
```
ERROR indexer.worker - upsert failed doc=acme-usr-421 cause=InvalidVectorDim expected=1536 received=1024
payload_meta: {"model":"open-embed-large-v2","batch":482}
```
They were on redwood-emb-1536, now on open-embed-large-v2 (1024). DB schema still expects 1536.

danielle: This explains it. Two tracks: (1) Restore service asap, (2) prevent reoccurrence.

alex: Immediate plan: pause the running backfill, flip their live ingestion back to redwood-emb-1536, run a safe backfill with validation. I can PR a small preflight validation to reject mismatched dims earlier.

patrick: Pausing job now. backfill-789 -> PAUSED by patrick at 2026-03-15T09:18:03Z. Also temporarily raising their ingest quota so manual queue can be drained if needed.

elaine: I reproduced locally in staging with a curl. Example:
```
curl -X POST "https://ingest.staging.redwood.ai/index" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"id":"acme-usr-421","embedding":[0.0,...(1024 floats)...] }'
```
Response:
{ "error":"InvalidVectorDim","expected":1536,"received":1024 }

maria_g: Customer also reported a spike in latency and a few 429 auth errors during the migration window. They retried a lot which likely amplified the issue.

danielle: Proposed actions:
- short: pause backfill (done), route live to previous model, smoke test sample
- medium: indexer preflight that checks embedding length vs index config and surfaces friendly error + metric
- long: model-catalog safety gate that warns or blocks default-model switches when an active backfill would be impacted

alex: I'll open PR to add dimension check to the indexer and a config flag auto_pause_on_invalid_dim=true. Unit tests included.

patrick: Ops change: when VecDB InvalidVectorDim occurs, auto-pause the job and open a runbook task: choose rollback vs re-encode vs schema migrate. We need this codified.

ingest-bot: job=789 retried_upserts=12 last_error=InvalidVectorDim

maria_g: Customer asked about options and timeline. Two immediate customer-facing choices:
1) Rollback model default (fast)
2) Re-encode affected docs with 1536 encoder (slower, uses embedding units)

elaine: Repro script I used in staging to simulate mixed dims:
```
python tools/sim_backfill.py --index acme_test --model open-embed-large-v2 --batch-size 128 --dry-run
```
It surfaced the same mismatch quickly.

danielle: For re-encode path we must: ensure deterministic input (text hasn't changed), record embedding version, tag docs with embedding_version, bill for extra units (CSM/finance to confirm), and run in waves with validation.

alex: Quick inline re-encode snippet (pseudo):
```
for d in batch:
  vec = embed(d.text, model="redwood-emb-1536")
  if len(vec)!=1536: raise Error
  upsert(index, d.id, vec)
```
Add abort-on-failure safety.

patrick: I'm scheduling a customer call in 30m and creating an incident ticket. Assigning runbook owner: danielle; hotfix PR: alex; CSM: olga_csm.

maria_g: Customer accepted rollback to previous model for immediate recovery. They're okay with a later re-encode plan if we provide ETA and cost estimate.

ingest-bot: event=change-default-model customer=acmeart old_model=open-embed-large-v2 new_model=redwood-emb-1536 by=patrick time=2026-03-15T09:42:10Z

danielle: Follow-ups I'm creating: GH project for model-catalog-dim-check, indexer preflight PR + tests, runbook automation task, billing decision ticket for re-encode costs.

patrick: Draft PR link (hotfix): https://github.com/redwood-inference/indexer/pull/1647 (adds dim validation, config flag, tests). Please review @alex @danielle.

finance: Noted on billing. We'll coordinate with CSM post-call to decide on cost absorption vs billing the migration re-encodes.

danielle: Ops resume checklist (recommended):
- verify index_config.dim matches chosen encoder
- sample-validate ~100 docs before full run
- run backfill in waves: batch=64 concurrency=4 sleep_ms=500
- alert if any InvalidVectorDim > 0 and auto-pause
- snapshot index before large runs

alex: I'll include the config option auto_pause_on_invalid_dim in the PR and add monitoring metrics for invalid-dim events.

maria_g: Customer is back to normal search for now after rollback. I'll keep this thread updated about acceptance and scheduling for eventual re-encode backfill. Thanks team :heart:

patrick: Closing operational incident once CSM confirms stability. Great triage, everyone.
